corrections: Replaced generic tandem helicopter with authored CH-47F shell, tapered fuel sponsons, rising cargo ramp, fore/aft transmission pylons, outboard T55 nacelles and fixed four-leg landing gear.

Set 11.8618m rotor-hub spacing, 18.288m rotor diameter, 15.4686m fuselage length and 6.858m wheelbase from dimension drawing. Counter-rotating three-blade heads carry hub, links and drooped blade geometry.
Cut true round cabin windows and separate upper, lower and roof cockpit glazing. Expanded lower pilot windows after rendered inspection.
Rebuilt five portrait-display CAAS panel, central engine page, paired standby units, twin CDU pedestal, overhead switch banks and animated cyclic/thrust/pedal controls.
limitations: Published drawing labels all dimensions approximate; side profile shows a ground attitude and rotor coning/droop that differ from the modeled parked state. Front drawing is low resolution and not consistent enough for fine contour tolerances.

Cockpit photo is wide angle, with oblique outer screens and crew/kneeboard occlusions. Central display scale uses Collins dimensions; outer panel widths, coaming depth, seat placement and overhead switch spacing remain estimates.
Cargo seating, switches and avionics graphics are deliberately simplified. The photograph is a specific 2022 cockpit fit and does not establish every CH-47F equipment option.

controlReview.checks: Imported GLB control-point movement tested at positive and negative commands; all 20 aircraft pass. Cockpit pairs and all ten airplane exterior pairs visually inspected. Roll, pitch, rudder and declared pedal directions corrected; ailerons and full flap deployment corrected.
limitations: Checks cover existing bindings; Cherokee and Caravan pedal geometry is static.
Full control travel and flight response remain approximations unless independently dimensioned in the model reference notes.
This audit verifies movement; it does not upgrade legacy helicopter avionics or remove previously documented geometry limitations.
